sources.entry: 26. Midjourney Sref - A huge collection of 4700+ sref codes for Midjourney.

summary.name: Midjourney --sref codes library
summary.one_liner: A searchable web library of about 5,677 Midjourney --sref style reference codes, each meant to be pasted into a Midjourney prompt to reproduce a visual style.
use_cases: find a Midjourney style code to match a look
browse visual styles for image prompts
keep a quick reference of style codes
summary.what_it_does: The page is a reference library of 5,677 Midjourney --sref codes intended as style references for image prompts. It is organized as a quick reference guide covering each SREF code, its style, and workflow tips. It also offers a set of example prompts and a trending section showing what the community is using. A leaderboard ranks top contributors to the library. New sref codes are said to be added every month. The page is promoted by Melies, described as an AI creative studio for generating images, shots, and videos.
notable: 5,677 sref codes catalogued for Midjourney style references
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under image prompting
caveats: Depends on Midjourney, a separate paid image generator, to use the codes
Page is promoted by Melies, an AI creative studio, and the page does not describe pricing for the library itself
